candidate.answerReason: Adding 10 hours and 24 minutes to the correct sunrise time of 6:57 AM gives 5:21 PM.

methods.label: Add the daylight duration to sunrise
methods.explanation: Sunset occurs \(10\) hours and \(24\) minutes after sunrise. Ten hours after \(6{:}57\text{ AM}\) is \(4{:}57\text{ PM}\). Of the remaining \(24\) minutes, \(3\) minutes reach \(5{:}00\text{ PM}\), leaving \(21\) minutes. The sun therefore set at \(\boxed{5{:}21\text{ PM}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses elementary clock arithmetic and the 60-minute hour, appropriate for AMC 8.

candidate.annotationRationale: Finding an ending time from a starting time and duration is an elapsed-time task. Crossing the hour boundary uses the hour-minute conversion.
